description: Show which product categories an operator dominates. Returns categories ranked by the operator's brand count and observed buybox days in each. Use when the user asks 'what categories does this seller focus on', 'operator category breakdown', 'where does Amazon Warehouse dominate', or any category-scoped operator question.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

name: operator_category_dominance
